book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: KORIN KHRISAWBU KHATEI PAUL CAKUA UIHNINGNAH

content: Mehpathai sahlo bawkhangnah lahsong kong lehei naaning khatah ca va cia heh ka cawtah a hia ky be.

Ma hratei bawkhang dunah thinglung naa hnuipaw khah hnih neh ka, Masidonia raang cawngsaw sahlo khakhei ma kong lehei ka ca pachaw he. Akhaia raang cawngsaw sahlo cawh peh a pawtah ziakung tai khei a pachia thah he, tatah ching he neh ka, tua dunah thinglung naa hnuipaw takhei ming hlu vy cawh peh hrá pawtah aa thinglung a thosah he.

Canghrasala naaning naa kong letah ma rawng tei ka ca palaikhuipaw peh heh a longdepaw a cang ly nápawtah a mai pacia tah a ung thah he, tatah ka reipaw hratah a maipacia tah naa ung khy nápawtah uny sahlo heh ka va tawpaw he a cang.

Zecawtamaw tatah Masidonia cawngsaw pakheh kheh tah kama khatah a vong tua seh la, a pachia a paning lytah naa ungpaw a hmuh caco, kaaning hrahring zong ma tluh kaa ca zingpaw he khah kaa ning zeh a ka, naaning zong a zeh vy chichi a.

Macawtaco ma lungtho tei pé pawtah bia na kang ciapaw he ceh lahsong khah a ciasa tah naa chiá pawtah a ca baw ruapaw he tah uny sahlo va seisah hlang heh a chah a, tatah ka rawh. Ma tih taco naa lahsong cawh hnehchaipaw cang lytah ma lung teitah naa pehpaw a cangpaw khah a lang a.
Ma heh a thui thlang my lo. Thleci a cawngtei a vapaw taco, a cawngtei hré a ka, a hlupui a vapaw taco a hlupui a hré a.
Lungtho lali lytah a cang ly leh hreh chong tah cang lytah naa lungthing tah pépaw naa tahpaw naning khei pei my lo, zecawtamaw tatah lungtho teitah a peipaw khah Khazing taco a do.
Taico Khazing cawh ningdonah bonghnang a hlupui a ca pei khypaw he a cang cawtah naa hiapaw maikaw khah zening tahmai hnui he ceh ka, raichaw maikaw khah naa hre khy a.

content.text: “Ama taco mehsisah sahlo khah a lahsong sahlo cawh sai ngetei hmotah pei he ka,
a dingnah cawh chaizaw tah a hming paria thlang,”

content: Thleci a vatu khah thleci le e rua batui a peipaw Khazing taco naa hnuipaw vytei khah papungsah ka, taico naa dingnah a thuipa khah a kasah hrá a.

Zetih cai letah hmai sai a ngepaw naa cang khy nápawtah hnuirungnah a phingphing tah ca pei he ka, kaaning taitei aa hmuhpaw naa lahsong rawng takhei ming hlupui tah Khazing khah lawngbia a hlai he a.
Ma hming naa tuapaw tahei Khazing cawngsaw sahlo aa byhiapaw bawkhang long cang lytah Khazing khatah ming hlupui tah lawngbia a hlainah zong a chuasah.

Ma rai naa hrepaw takhei naa zingnah khah a langsah. Ming hlupui tah Khazing khah aa reithai a, zecawtamaw tatah Khri rei khah nge he ceh ka, a thawngchawbia khah zing he ceh ka, taico aaning khatah le ming hringpaw vytei khatah naa hnuichia zong chahnainge teitah naa hrongnah caw he ceh tah a cang.
Atoheh naa cawtah thlawchang leimei he ka, hmuh aa ca du he. Zecawtamaw tatah aaning khah bonghnang a hlupui tah pé pawtah Khazing tah naaning khah a ca hmang he.
Hmokaw tei reite a cang lypaw a lahsong rawng takhei Khazing letah a lawngnah bia hlai he peh!
